d:
Hello Ladies and Gents Tonight i wanna post something about my original character named lutaria she is based from a 2008 ds game called Advance wars days of ruin or dark conflict from european versions. this is a compilation of her lore and my backstories with commissions both 2d and 3d artworks from various artists such as Mayofreedom,Anderhorlo and NeedleHead Respectively Please Enjoy.

(Old Commissions Reposted from Now defunct pixiv page for archival purposes only)

Part 1: Lutaria's Death

lutaria is being killed by her sister tabitha from a training match as she said in the game that she went to hard on her lead to her death. as her corpse lay on the grass while tabitha looked down on it and said her words to her.

Tabitha: hmph! looks like i killed you lutaria you were too careless but i hope father would see the results on this training your body might be of use later for cloning and other uses father do.

Lutaria's Ghost: This can't be happening that i'm dead! it can't be! NOOOOOOO! i have so much to live for but why this have to happen T_T.

Lutaria was terrified to see herself dead from being stabbed in the chest to her heart that killed her instantly but now she's a spirit she was there but she was never seen anymore.

Part 2: Lutaria's Fate

Lutaria's Corpse was Lying in the morgue table while her spirit stares at it as she is accepting the fate of her death before dr.caulder could experiment her body with reanimating agent then her corpse would turned into a zombie that would turn out to be harmless and docile. but for now she haunts the morgue and other places play pranks on her siblings by making her presence known and moving objects around especially tabitha that killed her.

Part 3: Lutaria's Resurrection

lutaria's corpse zombified while the ghost of her happily cheered as she saw her dead body is literally resurrected but this is no ordinary zombie that attacks and eats anyone alive but a special type of zombie that was only to look for a prey to have sex for a male but also docile and harmless. the zombified corpse of lutaria can sense her ghost counterpart as well as hearing and seeing her as she was her former self like a six sense. before the battle of the nest dr.caulder injected a reanimating serum on her body that can resurrect dead bodies and zombifies them but he injected the docile and harmless one by mistake as he was in a hurry for the battle when the will and co of the 12th battalion came after him. during the battle her body reacts and make changes to her body such as getting wet from her vagina(and warmest spot) as well as natural sperm termination on her womb to prevent pregnancy from the serum reacted by it. also her saliva have aphrodisiac quality from kissing and licking that can make the prey calmed down and feel good for the fun things to do. after the battle the nest was destroyed but the morgue was still unscathed and undiscovered but now the zombified corpse of lutaria still wanders aimlessly waiting for a prey while her spirit linger and haunts the place. the zombie lutaria also can't decay nor age due to the serum injected in her. however for lutaria's ghost she have an ability to reincarnate and resurrect herself to an identical clone of her body so that she became human and alive again ofcourse they could be lutaria body clones lying around in the next room from the morgue when she needs it to be mortal again

Part 4: Lutaria's New Life

a room with a spare clone body were next to the morgue where lutaria's ghost and her Zombified corpse and now as they went to next room as she get tired from being a ghost she wants to be mortal again as the body was stored in a body pod in a stasis she put her soul inside the body by through consciousness transfer while the zombified corpse typing the keys to drain the water as the zombie is having intelligence despite being docile and harmless. as lutaria opened her eyes again in a corporeal form she ask her zombified counterpart.

Lutaria: "am i good looking sister? i'm glad i'm alive again! thanks for helping me out"

the zombie moans and nods as she's trying to say "not bad you look really good and you're welcome"

Part 5: Sister's Reunion(Epilogue)

after the events of the game lutaria went into the camp to scout ahead and seen isabella alone and they seen and hugged each other but they never met yet due to genetic memory and inheritance from caulder. they love each other at first sight.

Lutaria: well well isn't my little sister that i got cloned from father's experiments i'm so glad i met you hehe.

Isabella: so i heard you were i never seen you before but i feel we're more close i'm also glad and happy to see you.
